name: Waldorf Astoria Beverly Hills
positioning: Hotel on Wilshire Boulevard in Beverly Hills with rooms styled by Pierre-Yves Rochon, a La Prairie Spa, a rooftop pool and Gemma, a Pan-Asian restaurant 12 stories up
best_for: Food lovers who want a Tuscan steakhouse and a Pan-Asian rooftop restaurant in the same hotel
Suite guests who want airport car service and wellness extras with their booking

facts.text: The hotel is at 9850 Wilshire Boulevard in Beverly Hills.
Rooms are styled by interior designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and terraces with views of Beverly Hills and the Santa Monica Mountains.
Baldi is a Tuscan steakhouse led by Chef Edoardo 'Edo' Baldi, built on family recipes.
At Baldi, steaks are cooked over an olive wood-fired grill, alongside house-made pastas.
Bar Baldi's wine cellar emphasizes Italian regions, particularly Piedmont and Tuscany.
Gemma's menu includes dim sum, a 'from the wok' menu, sushi and grilled steaks including Japanese Wagyu.
Gemma's bar serves tiki-inspired cocktails such as a Scorpion bowl, Mai Tai and Pina colada, plus a list of sakes.
The hotel's La Prairie Spa has six treatment rooms.
Salon de Lucy, inside the hotel, offers haircuts, color, styling, makeup and men's grooming, and has been part of the hotel since its opening.
The lobby is Art Deco-inspired, with triple-height ceilings, two large chandeliers and a Bijan boutique.
The hotel is pet-friendly; dogs get a dog bed, bowls and treats.

highlights.text: Gemma is a Pan-Asian rooftop restaurant 12 stories above the city, with views of the Santa Monica Mountains and Beverly Hills.
Signature Suite bookings include private car service to and from LAX or Burbank airport, an in-suite bar cart, custom Diptyque scent, monogrammed sheets and a session with the Director of Wellness.
The Suite Ride offer gives suite guests access to a luxury vehicle such as a Rolls-Royce Cullinan or Bentley Bentayga.
The hotel has a rooftop pool; on a clear day you can see all the way to downtown.
Director of Wellness Tom McKiver, a registered nutritionist, leads personal training and nutrition programs.

considerations.text: Guests must be 16 or older to use the fitness center equipment.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium Beverly Hills location.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site parking in a dense urban setting.
